Resolve a worker-process count for forked parallelism

Source: R/fn_parallel.R
resolve_cores.Rd

Shared helper for the bootstrap routines (nb_exact_ci, bootstrap_correction). Defaults a NULL request to getOption("mc.cores", 1L), caps it at the number of independent jobs, forces serial on Windows (mclapply cannot fork there) and honours _R_CHECK_LIMIT_CORES_ (set during R CMD check and vignette knitting), which caps usable cores at 2.

Usage

resolve_cores(cores, cap)

Arguments

cores

Requested worker count, or NULL to read getOption("mc.cores", 1L).

cap

Upper bound on the count (the number of independent jobs).

Value

An integer worker count, at least 1.
